items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: And Mr. Kramer would come in for lunch and we'd be having tea, and, 'How are you son?'

ctx.x: She would say, 'Kenny, you hungry? Come on in and have some tea,' or something like that. And Mr. Kramer would come in for lunch and we'd be having tea, and, 'How are you son?' So and so, how's school, and things like that, and that was it.
